title: prominent done or assumed next
rule: Place the control that finishes the transaction (or the assumed next step) at the end of the visual flow; make it prominent and well labeled.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Doing Things — Prominent Done or Assumed Next Step (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: Finish / assumed-next sits at the end of the visual flow, is prominent, and is well labeled.
fail_when: That control is weak, unlabeled, or not at the end of the flow.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
